note: J1 open + a curve file = a 0–5 V sensor or the ECU's CAN value at the swap (D-262)

on_the_wire: PMU-excited node: 100 Ω 1 W from pin 15 at the dash node; A7 reads it (D-260)
carrier_stage: No pull-up on the carrier — read only: 15 kΩ / 10 kΩ divider → 100 nF → BAT54S

note: The fuel-pump gate is the PMU's on A7, never this input (D-251). At the swap a 0–5 V transducer replaces the sender and the 100 Ω pull-up is lifted at N39 (D-262)

note: Was the PMU's A7 until D-249; the ICU is the only source now. The tank unit outlives the swap

on_the_wire: Trailing coil negative primary (luxury D-304) — inductive kick, hundreds of volts

calibration: 2 pulses per revolution; tach_simulator on the bench, then the car
note: D-273 confirms the parts; an H11L1 opto is the alternative if the comparator picks up noise. An ECU tach output (0–12 V square wave) uses the same stage at the swap; pulses per rev is a config value
